name: plain
why: A static page every tool should get right.

name: fade-300
why: Short entrance fade.

name: fade-1200
why: A captured mid-fade page looks washed out.

name: fade-3000
why: Slow hero fade, common on marketing sites.

name: fade-delay-1000
why: Content is invisible until the animation delay ends.

name: fade-delay-2500
why: A long delay looks like an empty page that's already settled.

name: slide-800
why: Content starts off-screen and slides in.

name: loop
why: An endless animation must not block the capture.

name: late-200
why: Content inserted by JS just after load.

name: late-1000
why: Content inserted by JS a second after load, with no loading signal.

name: spa-500
why: Spinner, then data from a fast API.

name: spa-2000
why: Spinner, then data from a slow API.

name: spa-4000
why: Spinner past most tools' settle limits.

name: skeleton-1500
why: Shimmering skeletons look like a finished page.

name: skeleton-3500
why: Skeletons held for a slow API.

name: hydrate-800
why: Server HTML is hidden until the app hydrates.

name: iframe-1000
why: Late content inside an iframe.

name: canvas-800
why: A chart drawn on a canvas after load; the DOM never changes.

name: img-500
why: An image that arrives after half a second.

name: img-2500
why: A slow hero image.

name: bg-1500
why: A CSS background image; waiting on tags misses it.

name: lazy-4000
why: A lazy image below the fold loads only if the page is scrolled.

name: reveal-3000
why: Scroll-reveal content stays transparent until it's scrolled into view.

name: tall-6000
why: Content at the bottom of a tall page.

name: tall-20000
why: Past Chrome's 16k-pixel texture limit at 1x.

name: infinite
why: An endless feed must not hang a full-page capture.

name: hang
why: A request that never finishes must not block the capture.

name: cookie-banner
why: A banner that slides in over the bottom of the page.

name: consent-wall
why: A full-screen consent dialog hides the page.

name: dark
why: Content only shown with prefers-color-scheme: dark.

name: mobile
why: Content only shown below 500 px wide.

name: signin-form
why: A sign-in form served in place, with no redirect.

name: signin-oauth
why: Only 'Continue with Google/Apple' buttons, no password field.

name: signin-late-1200
why: Like access.mymind.com: an empty page renders its sign-in screen from JS, then fades in.

name: signin-late-300
why: JS-rendered sign-in screen, quick.

name: login-redirect
why: HTTP redirect to /login.

name: js-login-redirect
why: A JS redirect to /login after load.

name: http-404
why: A 404 must not be reported as a plain success.

name: http-500
why: A server error page.

name: http-403
why: Forbidden.

name: notfound-200
why: A 'Page not found' page served with HTTP 200.

name: challenge-403
why: A Cloudflare-style 'Just a moment...' interstitial.

name: challenge-503
why: Challenge served as 503.

name: challenge-200
why: Challenge served as 200.

name: blank
why: An empty page.

name: blank-js
why: The app's script crashed and nothing rendered.

name: white-on-white
why: The DOM has text, but the image is blank.

name: live-mymind
why: Signed out: a JS-rendered sign-in screen. Iris returned a blank image as ok on 2026-11-23.

name: live-example
why: A trivial live page.

name: live-wikipedia
why: A tall live page with many images.

name: live-hn
why: A dense text page.

name: live-github-404
why: A real 404.

name: live-tailwind-dark
why: A heavy marketing page with animations, in dark mode.
